svg.title: What one AGV assignment adds to the DAG
svg.desc: Assigning AGV B to TrayMove e4 adds AgvMove(to tray), lift, sets agv_id on the TrayMove, and adds lower, with four kinds of dependency edges.

g.text: Matching only picks pairs; the loop that follows turns each pair into real events and wires them into the DAG so motion planning can replay them safely.
